items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yes, Norbert Fraconi. And she had them all to come to the Barbarina and listen to the orchestra and everything.

ctx.x: She also invited all of the top band leaders, like Marek Weber, and Darius Bela, Ephaim Schachtmeister, and who else?
Oh, yes, Norbert Fraconi. And she had them all to come to the Barbarina and listen to the orchestra and everything. So, she really sent the orchestra.
And after three months, within fifteen days, I had an option for another three months. Within fifteen days, I had an option.
